# bb

bb bootstrap, appended to every thread bb runs here regardless of the agent it starts.
The repository's provider-neutral AI context lives under [`.ai/`](.ai/); nothing specific
to bb is needed here, and the agent bb runs loads its own bootstrap on top of this one
(`CLAUDE.md`, or `AGENTS.md`), which says the same thing.

Read `README.md`, then [`.ai/README.md`](.ai/README.md), and follow its
discovery protocol: the effective rules under `.ai/repo/rules/` with their
dependencies, the workflows and knowledge the task needs, and never `.ai/local/`.

This repository is supervised by Majordomus. Run `majordomus context` before working;
the task lifecycle is `.ai/repo/workflows/task-lifecycle.md`; the default profile is
`implementation`. A rule that exists in this file and not in `.ai/` is a bug.

Linked git worktrees of this repository live at `<repository>-wt/<branch>`, derived from
git and never chosen. A managed bb worktree is not one of them: to the worktree topology it
is a session's scratch checkout, reported, never moved, and the pre-commit hook refuses a
feature-branch commit from it. Commit from the project checkout, or continue in the
branch's canonical worktree (`majordomus worktree create <branch>`). The rule is
`project.worktree-topology`; the mechanism is `docs/WORKTREES.md`.
